hook.say: Five Turkish cities, five questions. Easy at the start, but the last one catches most people out!

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!

questions.q: In which city is Anıtkabir, the mausoleum of Atatürk?
questions.say: In which city is Anit-kabir, the mausoleum of Ataturk?
questions.fact: Anıtkabir was completed in 1953 in the capital, Ankara.
questions.sayAnswer: Ankara! The mausoleum was completed in 1953 in the capital.

questions.q: Which Turkish city was known in antiquity as Smyrna?
questions.say: Which Turkish city was known in ancient times as Smyrna?
questions.fact: İzmir is Türkiye's third most populous city, on the Aegean coast.
questions.sayAnswer: Izmeer! It is Turkey's third most populous city, on the Aegean coast.

questions.q: Which city holds Rumi's tomb and is home of the whirling dervishes?
questions.say: Which city holds Rumi's tomb and is home of the whirling dervishes?
questions.fact: Rumi's turquoise-domed tomb is now the Mevlana Museum.
questions.sayAnswer: Konya! Rumi's turquoise-domed tomb is now the Mevlana Museum.

questions.q: Licence plates starting with 01 belong to which province?
questions.say: Licence plates starting with zero one belong to which province?
questions.fact: Adana is 01, Ankara is 06 and Istanbul is 34.
questions.sayAnswer: Adana! Adana is zero one, Ankara is zero six, and Istanbul is 34.

questions.q: Which is Türkiye's smallest province by area?
questions.say: Which is Turkey's smallest province by area?
questions.fact: Yalova covers only about 850 square kilometres.
questions.sayAnswer: Yalova! It covers only about 850 square kilometres.
